thumbnail.generation_prompt: Revise this finished thumbnail. Preserve exact layout, all three text blocks, the two downed soldiers, foreground medic's bandage and reaching hand, and the industrial rooftop. Required text verbatim: "나 메딕인데…?", "살리러 왔다가 같이 누움ㅋㅋ", "WARDOGS". Critical changes: (1) Remove the human silhouette embedded in WARDOGS and replace with a normal fully readable letter O. Use plain bold compact white WARDOGS game-name lettering, no invented logo symbols. (2) Make the entire scene visibly a REAL-TIME TACTICAL PC GAME SCREENSHOT aesthetic, substantially less photographic: the foreground character must be a 3D videogame NPC with smooth simplified skin, NO photo pores, NO stubble microtexture, geometric face planes, clearly rendered eyes, lower-detail in-game cloth and helmet textures; moderate polygonal asset detail and crisp game-engine ambient occlusion, broad even daylight, sharper background than a cinema photo. Keep a middle-aged sheepish confused face but render as game character, not live-action actor. Olive and khaki equipment, darker green vest, grey steel industrial rooftop, tactical military sandbox. Not cartoon or anime, not a movie poster. Dramatic change from live-action photography to convincingly game-rendered soldiers is mandatory. Maintain readable white/yellow Korean typography and safe margins. No added UI or extra text. Complete 16:9 thumbnail.
